result.narrative:
Nordkrans Steel Traders AB is showing early distress on two fronts. With Nordhaven Trade Credit (CL05) it has two open invoices totalling EUR 218,600, the worst 25 days past due (EUR 150,700), and the settled history is deteriorating — 0→3→0→13 days late across the last four settled invoices. Against that, a live report dated 20 September 2026 says the company has missed payroll for a second consecutive month, with union talks stalled. The only other news on file is two years-old severity 0 items about capacity expansion and a Nordic distribution tie-up, both of which decay to 0.

The score is 47.7 (PD 0.3767), placing the buyer in Watch: 0.65 x 33.3 (payment, 25 DPD) + 0.35 x 74.3 (news) = 47.7. The adjudicator agreed with caveats rather than endorsing the band outright. Their point is that the band is load-bearing on one thinly-sourced article: LIVE01 contributes 26.0 of the 47.7 points, and without it the score is 21.7, which is Healthy. The article rests on three workers at the Malmo yard speaking to the paper, with no management, union or filing confirmation, and the publication is recorded as "Live input". They also flag that the payment file is dated 31 August 2026, twenty days before the payroll report, so 25 DPD may be a stale snapshot, and that the EUR 1.46m limit was last reviewed in November 2024, so the headroom over current exposure should not be read as mitigation.

The recommended action is a REDUCE on LIM0025 with Nordhaven Trade Credit, cutting the limit from EUR 1,460,000 to EUR 968,941 — the point at which expected loss meets the 25% appetite (PD 0.3767 against a 0.25 target). Expected loss falls from EUR 420,736 to EUR 279,225. The revised limit still sits well above the EUR 218,600 currently owed, so the cut closes off unreviewed drawdown capacity rather than squeezing existing trade. Given the adjudicator's caveats, this should go out alongside verification of the payroll report and a refreshed payment file.

What would lift it: if LIVE01 is not confirmed, the news leg falls away and the score drops to 21.7, below the 35.0 Healthy threshold — the file needs 12.7 points of improvement to get there. Clearing the EUR 150,700 past-due invoice and restoring on-time settlement would do the same work from the payment side. Conversely, the buyer is 12.3 points from High Risk at 60.0, which 37 DPD would reach on the payment leg alone.
